title: 第十三章龙战VS凶鸟王第十四章突破通天境后期
content_zh:
就连凶鸟王听到这个名字时，也不由瞳孔收缩，心中暗惊道：“不会吧？这龙城有这个本事能将人皇请来？不好说，龙战毕竟是龙城之主，而龙城又是人皇手里的城池，只要龙战愿意付出一些代价，说不定，人皇还真会过来......”
“这小子到底在龙家做了什么事情？”
“居然能让龙战付出不惜代价，都要将他抓到？”
“莫非是绿了这家伙的？”
“不会吧......”
就在凶鸟王心有所想时，龙战声如洪钟道：“希望你到时候还能够这样保护那小子，凶鸟王！！”
“我们走！”
话落，龙战转身离去。
而一旁的龙云沁却用恶狠狠的目光盯着凶鸟王道：“等死吧，你这头该死的杂毛鸟！！”
此言一出，龙战等龙家长老们，顿时神情骤变。
因为他们知道，凶鸟王最痛恨人类以及凶兽叫它杂毛鸟，因为这是对它身为凶兽最大的语言羞辱。
“快走！！”
来不及多想，龙战连忙拽起自己的女儿，朝着哀山外快速飞了出去。
其余长老们也都个个色变，化为一道道灵光，破空消失。
就在此时！！
凶鸟王眼神凶狠，张开它那一对巨大的羽翼道：“不知死活的丫头！！居然干羞辱本王！！就算你们龙家去请来人皇，本王也要将这丫头的嘴巴撕烂！！”
“孩儿们！”
“从此刻起，无休止追杀龙城修士，无论是不是龙家族人，都不放过！！”
“给本王，杀！！！”
话落瞬间，凶鸟王以极快的速度追上了龙家几位长老。

只见飞射而出无数根冷冽至极的羽毛，犹如寒光般冰冷，射向龙家长老团们。
而在其身后！！
数十只凶鸟飞扑而来，嘴里喷涌而出一股股强大的灵火能量，轰击龙战等人。
突如其来的战斗，让众人都始料不及。
即便是那些隐匿在四周的凶兽们也没想到，明明能够和平收场，却因为龙家圣女的一句话，便让局势顺转直下，爆发出了这般战斗。
“都说龙战乃是龙城豪杰，身为登天境修士，放眼整个东土大陆，也算是强者了。”
“却没想到生出来的子女却这般不堪。”
“据说这一次龙战所追杀之人，正是他之前所收养过的养子，乃是龙城妖孽，天赋极高，未来可期。”
“真不知道，好端端的养子，怎么就成为叛徒了？？”
“谁知道呢，可能是这位养子，触碰了龙家不该触碰的东西，所以才会被冠上叛徒之名吧。”
“而且，最近不是有龙城修士在说，龙家圣子，龙云飞被秦风给重创了么？”
“估计就是因为这事吧。”
“哦？正有意思，养子揍亲生儿子，而且还没手下留情，看来这仇是有点大了，难怪龙战如此发狂。”
“宁愿付出这么大代价，也要找到这个叫秦风的小子。”
“要是让我们找到这小子，是不是也能去领一杯羹呢？”
“必须能，正好现在凶鸟王不在领地，本王倒要去看看，这家伙是不是真的将与他无关的人类小子给藏起来了。”
“嘿嘿嘿！”
“......”
content_en:
Even the Fierce Bird King couldn't help but shrink his pupils when he heard this name, and was shocked in his heart: "No way? Does this Dragon City have the ability to invite the Human Emperor? It's hard to say, after all, Long Zhan is the master of Dragon City, and Long City is the city in the hands of the Human Emperor. As long as Long Zhan is willing to pay some price, maybe the Human Emperor will come..."
"What on earth did this kid do in the Long family?"
"You can actually make Long Zhan pay any price to catch him?"
"Could it be that he fell in love with this guy?"
"No way..."
Just when the Fierce Bird King was thinking about it, Long Zhan's voice sounded like a bell: "I hope you can protect that kid like this when the time comes, Fierce Bird King!!"
"Let's go!"
After saying that, Long Zhan turned and left.
But Long Yunqin on the side stared at the King of Fierce Birds with a vicious look and said: "Wait to die, you damn bastard bird!!"
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of Long Zhan and other elders from the Long family suddenly changed.
Because they know that the King of Fierce Birds hates humans and ferocious beasts the most. Calling it a bastard bird is the biggest verbal insult to it as a ferocious beast.
"Go quickly!!"
Without any time to think, Long Zhan quickly picked up his daughter and flew out quickly towards the outside of Aishan.
The expressions of the other elders also changed, and they turned into rays of spiritual light and disappeared through the sky.
Right now! !
The King of Ferocious Birds had fierce eyes, opened its pair of huge wings and said: "You don't know how to live or die! You actually humiliate me!! Even if your Long family goes to invite the Human Emperor, I will tear this girl's mouth to pieces!!"
"Children!"
"From now on, we will endlessly hunt down the Dragon City monks, no matter whether they are members of the Long family or not!!"
"Give it to me, kill!!!"
The moment he finished speaking, the Fierce Bird King caught up with several elders of the Long family at extremely fast speeds.
I saw countless extremely cold feathers flying out, as cold as cold light, shooting towards the elders of the Long family.
And behind it! !
Dozens of fierce birds swooped in, spurting out streams of powerful spiritual fire energy from their mouths, bombarding Long Zhan and the others.
The sudden battle caught everyone by surprise.
Even the ferocious beasts hiding around did not expect that it could end peacefully, but because of a word from the Saint of the Long Family, the situation took a turn for the worse and such a battle broke out.
"It is said that Long Zhan is a hero of Dragon City. As a monk in the Heaven Realm, he can be considered a strong man when looking at the entire Eastern Continent."
"But I didn't expect that the children born would be so miserable."
"It is said that the person Long Zhan is chasing this time is the adopted son he adopted before. He is a demon from Dragon City. He is extremely talented and has a promising future."
“I really don’t know why my adopted son, who is so well behaved, became a traitor??”
"Who knows, maybe this adopted son touched something that the Long family shouldn't touch, so he was called a traitor."
"Moreover, aren't some Dragon City monks saying recently that Long Yunfei, the holy son of the Long family, was seriously injured by Qin Feng?"
"It's probably because of this."
"Oh? It's interesting. The adopted son beat up his biological son and showed no mercy. It seems that the revenge is a bit big. No wonder Long Zhan is so crazy."
"I would rather pay such a high price to find this boy named Qin Feng."
"If we find this kid, can we also get a piece of the pie?"
"It must be possible. It just so happens that the Ferocious Bird King is not in the territory right now. I want to go and see if this guy has really hidden a human boy who has nothing to do with him."
"Hey hey hey!"
"..."
